sessionChecks: on opens an interactive protected Bash without eval
doctor confirms the terminal is active
on does not nest a second shell while already active
history is disabled and inherited startup hooks are cleared
Ctrl-C at the prompt keeps the protected session alive
normal npx clean install succeeds without a prompt
trapped skill stays inactive when default cancellation is selected
explicit exception installs the exact fingerprint
exit leaves the protected shell and returns success
on reopens via the same project path alias after exit
limitations: Static financial rules are heuristic, not a safety certification.
Interactive session covers supported installers and descendants inheriting its PATH.
Raw workstation paths and transcripts are excluded.
